text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services has been directed by North York Community Council to investigate and report back on a speed limit reduction on collector and minor arterial streets in Ward 15 from 50 km/h to 40 km/h. The review disclosed the implementation of a 40 km/h speed limit is warranted on six streets and is recommended to address safety concerns expressed by the Ward Councillor and area residents.
North York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until its next meeting on June 6, 2018.
